senior_lines: A lady from Singtel called me. Very polite, she knew my IC number. She said a phone line under my name was used for a crime.
Then she passed me to an officer from the Ministry of Law. He said I must move my savings to an account for checking, and I must not tell my son, and I must stay on the line until it is done.
He sounded very professional, so I think it is real. I just want to check with you first.
Yes, that's right.
